name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 69 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-06-15, at wavelengths from 1.71 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
